items.title: 7.2.2 Kimiyai reaction ki rate napna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.2.2, printed pages 147-148.

blocks.text: Reaction ki rate napne ka matlab reaction ke aage barhne ke saath ba-qaida waqfon par kisi reactant ya product ki concentration tai karna hai. Concentration (y-axis) ka waqt (x-axis) ke muqable graph ek curve deta hai. 500 degrees C par HI ke H2 aur I2 mein tootne ke liye Table 7.1 ka data girta curve deta hai, kyunke HI reactant hai. Curve ki dhalwan reaction ki pesh-raft zahir karti hai: shuru ke qareeb dhalwan jitni zyada, rate utni zyada. Maslan 100 seconds par rate napne ke liye wahan curve par tangent kheenchein aur us ki dhalwan napein: tangent ko watar (hypotenuse) bana kar qaima-zawiya tikon mukammal karein; 100 s wala tangent taqreeban 160 s mein 0.04 mol dm-3 girta hai, to rate = 0.04 / 160 = 2.5 x 10^-4 mol dm-3 s-1. Is ka matlab us lamhe HI concentration har second taqreeban 2.5 x 10^-4 mol dm-3 ghat rahi hai. Kisi product, H2 ya I2, ki concentration ka graph barhta curve deta hai jis ka 100 s par tangent wahi rate deta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne 100 s par rate = 0.04 / 100 = 4 x 10^-4 mol dm-3 s-1 likha hai. Lekin Figure 7.2 mein tangent ka 0.04 mol dm-3 ka girna taqreeban 160 s mein hota hai, 100 s mein nahi; is liye rate = 0.04 / 160 = taqreeban 2.5 x 10^-4 mol dm-3 s-1 hai. Table 7.1 bhi yehi deti hai: 50 s se 150 s tak (0.0716 - 0.0457) / 100 = 2.6 x 10^-4. Kitab ki apni agli satar bhi '2.5' kehti hai, lekin 'moles per dm3' ke saath; sahi 2.5 x 10^-4 mol dm-3 har second hai.

blocks.alt: [HI] (0 se 0.10 mol dm-3) ka Time (s) (0 se 350) ke muqable grid graph. Hara girta curve 0.10 se shuru ho kar 50 se 350 s tak peele nuqton se guzarta hai. Neela tangent curve ko 100 s par chhoota hai aur y-axis par 0.08 se 0.04 ke neeche tak jata hai. Qaima-zawiya tikon ABC: A (0.08) se C (0.04) tak y-axis par khari lakeer, label 0.04 mol dm-3, aur C se tangent par B (taqreeban 164 s) tak ufuqi lakeer.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.2: 508 degrees C par reaction 2HI(g) se H2(g) + I2(g) mein waqt ke saath HI ki concentration ki tabdeeli (kitab ki Figure 7.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ke graph par y-axis ka label '[H1]' (ek ka hindsa) chhapa hai aur axes ke harf ulte hain (X oopar, Y daen); yahan [HI] aur aam riwaj ke mutabiq Y oopar, X daen likha gaya hai. Tikon ka ufuqi hissa CB tangent tak taqreeban 164 s lamba hai, is liye 100 s par rate = 0.04 / 164 = taqreeban 2.5 x 10^-4 mol dm-3 s-1 hai.

blocks.caption: Waqt ke saath HI ki concentration mein tabdeeli, 2HI se H2 + I2 (Table 7.1)

blocks.prompt: Table 7.1 se shuru, 100 s aur 300 s par rate ka muqabla karein, aur batayein ke kis concentration par rate sab se zyada aur sab se kam hai.
blocks.explanation: 0 aur 50 s ke darmiyan concentration 0.0284 mol dm-3 girti hai, taqreeban 5.7 x 10^-4 mol dm-3 s-1; 100 s par tangent taqreeban 2.5 x 10^-4 deta hai; 250 aur 300 s ke darmiyan girawat 0.004 mol dm-3 hai, taqreeban 8 x 10^-5 mol dm-3 s-1. Rate shuru mein sab se zyada hai, jab [HI] 0.10 mol dm-3 hai, aur 300 s par sab se kam, jab yeh taqreeban 0.03 mol dm-3 hai: rate concentration ke girne ke saath girti hai.

items: Concentration ko waqt ke muqable plot karein; chune hue waqt par tangent ki dhalwan wahan ki rate hai: HI 100 s par, 0.04 mol dm-3 / taqreeban 160 s = 2.5 x 10^-4 mol dm-3 s-1; product curve wahi qeemat deta hai.
